summary: End-anchored reverse DFA searches passed the original haystack length as an offset into &text[start..], causing an out-of-bounds panic for nonzero start offsets. The fix uses text.len() - start in shortest_match_at and is_match_at. This reversal restores only the shortest_match_at defect, exercised by the fix-added regression_i969 test in tests/test_default.rs (Cargo test target default): searching c.*d\z in "ababcd" from offset 4 should return Some(6). No tests were run.
expected_failure: index out of bounds: the len is 2 but the index is 6
